title: League won't allow Dae'Quan Wright or Zxavian Harris to sign with NFL teams

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: League won't allow Dae'Quan Wright or Zxavian Harris to sign with NFL teams
sources.description: The two former pro players who received clearance to sign with LSU but then weren't actually used by LSU remain SOL as it relates to the NFL.
